content.text: Submitted. The repaired fallback proposal now carries all six atomic elements: operation 1 fixes duration ("12 months from the end of their involvement in the Services") and scope ("directly involved in the Services") inside the existing sentence, and operation 2 adds one concise sentence making the restriction mutual with express general-advertisement and unsolicited-approach carve-outs. The clause remains solicitation-only, so "no no-hire" is already met in the source text. All official and precision checks pass, and the minimality gate is satisfied.
